claim: Source citation for section 3: https://www.gainescpacfo.com/our-accounting-services.htm is described as a 'service list including tax planning and tax preparation'.
problem: Re-opened the page. Its service sections are Accounting and Bookkeeping, Financial Services, Payroll, QuickBooks, and Estate and Trust Planning. Tax planning and tax preparation appear only in the site-wide Tax Services navigation/footer, not in that page's service list. The underlying business claim is true (dedicated tax pages exist), but the cited URL does not support it as described.
fix: Cite https://www.gainescpacfo.com/tax-planning-services.htm and https://www.gainescpacfo.com/income-tax-preparation-services.htm for the tax claim, or say 'the site's Tax Services menu lists tax planning and tax preparation'.

claim: 'Several lines are sold as recurring monthly services' and 'Payroll, AP/AR, reconciliations and month-end close are offered as recurring monthly services'.
problem: The outsourced-accounting page lists payroll processing, AP/AR, credit-card and bank reconciliations and month-end closings, and describes ongoing outsourcing, but publishes no engagement cadence or pricing. 'Recurring monthly' is an inference; payroll recurs per pay cycle, not monthly. It is presented as fact in the intro and section 1 'Now' without an inference label.
fix: Soften to 'offered as ongoing outsourced services, including month-end closings' or add '(our inference from the service list)' and keep 'monthly' tied to month-end close and reconciliations.

claim: Section 2 impact: 78-156 triage hours valued at $60.59/hour (accountants and auditors median, NJ, 2025, x1.25).
problem: The work described - answering the form, callbacks and consult triage - is typically administrative/front-desk. Section 1 explicitly labels the accountant grade as an assumption; section 2 does not, so the dollar range may be roughly double an administrative-rate estimate. Hours and arithmetic are correct; the rate grade is unlabeled.
fix: Value section 2 at an administrative/office-support benchmark, or add 'grade choice our assumption' and state that the range is illustrative.

claim: BLS source URLs https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUS340000000000013201113 and https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUS340000000000013208213 support the two medians.
problem: Both endpoints returned 'REQUEST_NOT_PROCESSED - daily threshold ... reached' when re-opened, so the audit's own links currently show an error to the founder. The values are correct: $100,830 ($48.48/hour) and $43,420 ($20.88/hour), May 2025 New Jersey, confirmed through a BLS OEWS-derived mirror.
fix: Keep the values but add a human-readable BLS OEWS state page (or the mirror used, https://fedsalary.com/us/jobs/accountants-and-auditors/new-jersey/ and https://fedsalary.com/us/jobs/tax-preparers/new-jersey/) and retain the note to re-check before quoting.

claim: 'You run an Edison CPA firm that leads with virtual CFO and outsourced accounting...'
problem: The homepage leads with virtual CFO and business turnaround services and lists outsourced accounting as one CFO service line. Calling outsourced accounting a lead positioning slightly overstates the site's emphasis. Minor characterization, not a hard factual error.
fix: Say 'leads with virtual CFO work, including outsourced accounting' to match the homepage.
